title: 100 Days of Love
desc: A columnist reunites with his childhood rival and unexpectedly falls in love. However, just as he gathers the courage to confess, he discovers that she is engaged to another.

title: Theeya Velai Seiyyanum Kumaru
desc: Kumar falls for Sanjana and seeks guidance from Mokia, a love guru, to win her heart. However, things take a dramatic turn when Sanjana turns out to be Mokia's sister.

title: Vinaya Vidheya Rama
desc: Facing a menacing criminal kingpin, Ram fights to protect his family. Soon, he embarks on a daring mission to topple the villain and dismantle his corrupt empire.

title: Lucky Baskhar
desc: Desperate to bring his family out of monetary woes, Bhaskar Kumar, a bank employee, enters the dangerous and murky world of financial scams.

title: Nadungaadhey Illathil Pei
desc: A man poses as a tantric to earn money for his love interest's orphanage. However, things take a turn when a ghost begins to follow him after he pretends to perform an exorcism.

title: Raatchasi
desc: Lieutenant Colonel Geetha Rani implements different plans to reform an undisciplined government school. However, she faces numerous challenges in her way, including a corrupt MLA.

title: Aaru Adi Bullet
desc: A young man is looked down upon by his father due to his irresponsible behaviour. He soon gets embroiled in a tussle with an egoistic gangster who threatens his family.
